title: Seetharamam
desc: Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.

title: Ullasa Uthsaha
desc: A wayward youngster's life takes a turn after he falls head over heels in love with a beautiful maiden. However, he must make a painful choice after learning about the maiden's childhood love story.

title: Lakshmi
desc: Lakshminarayana, a CBI officer, is drawn into a dangerous conspiracy when his wife Priya vanishes after discovering hidden weapons, leading him on a mission that uncovers shocking truths.

title: Chalaki
desc: Due to the demands of their students, a male student is admitted at an all-girls college. But new student Aditya, who dislikes studies, hopes that like in the past, this time too he will be suspended.

title: Kirik Party
desc: Karna, a first-year engineering student, falls in love with Saanvi, a final-year pupil from his college. However, a tragic event changes his perception towards life and he mends his ways.
